newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta shares end marginally up, off highs.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta shares end marginally up, off highs.

text.p: Jakarta shares ended slightly up but off highs on Thursday with some speculative buying of second- and third-liners, brokers said.
The composite index rose 0.48 point, or 0.08 percent, to close at 589.79 after reaching a day high of 592.63 points. Gainers led losers by 61 to 49, with 44 counters unchanged.
"The market seemed lethargic today. But I think its normal, after three days rally, technically it need to cool down," said one foreign broker.

"But I think the Jakarta market has come back to normal conditions now. Inflation is under control, so if the Dow continues gains tonight I expect market will be more active tomorrow," said another foreign broker.
Brokers said many small-capitalised stocks become a target of speculative buying as many local brokers sold stocks which have made gains in the past few days.
The brokers were seen to be switching portfolios on perceptions that some counters had reached peak prices and were cashing out short-term gains.
Property firm Duta Pertiwi topped the active list with 13 million shares traded, up 75 rupiah to 2,125 rupiah.
Brokers said this was partly due to expectations that its 500-hectare residential project in Cibubur, West Java, would have a favourable impact on company earnings.

But some said it was due to a report that Duta Pertiwi and Smart Corporation, two companies in the Sinar Mas Group, would become part of Amcol Holdings of Singapore, which Sinar Mas is currently seeking to take over.
Smart Corporation was also actively traded and ended unchanged at 1,925 rupiah on a volume of 1.7 million shares.
Company officials were not available for comment.
Timber firm Barito Pacific rose 25 rupiah to 1,450 rupiah on a volume of 8.7 million shares on market talk of a possible restructuring of the company, which could not be confirmed.
Noodle and food products firm Indofood rose 175 rupiah to 5,175 on a volume of 2.5 million shares. Brokers said it was due to fresh buying as some investors were switching portfolios.
Telkom fell 25 rupiah to 3,800 on a volume of 2.6 million shares on profit-taking after making significant gains in the last two days. -- Jakarta newsroom +6221 384-6364
